ballot_text.type_quote: Amendment G proposes amending the Colorado Constitution to:

fact.quote: Modify Property Tax Exemption for Veterans with Disabilities Placed on the ballot by the legislature • Passes with 55 percent of the vote
fact.why: Text amends art. X sec. 3.5 (1)(c) and (1.5) (changes eligibility wording). Blue Book says 'adopting a constitutional amendment requires at least 55 percent of the votes cast, except that when a constitutional amendment is limited to a repeal, it requires a simple majority vote. Each analysis identifies the vote required for the measure to pass.' and prints this measure's vote required in the quoted line; applies is read from that statement (55 percent means not limited to a repeal).
